Arun (infra): FYI - us-central dedicated-pool-4 showing sustained slab churn since 13:02 UTC; early signs point to noisy neighbor embedding sweep.
Lena (sre): saw the p99 surge. Which tenant? Any dedicated slices at risk?
Arun (infra): tenant:eventhorizon has a large background sweep spawning many workers. Dedicated slices are healthy but adjacent soft-affinity tenants saw increased kv-eviction.
Diego (platform): we should avoid evicting paid dedicated slices. Proposal: enforce a temporary per-tenant egress softcap + route their batch prefixes to preemptible-cold to drain IO pressure.
Marta (sales-eng): eventhorizon is enterprise - we need to coordinate. I'll message their TAM; prefer routing non-prod work off-dedicated.
infra-oncall: capacity check: dedicated headroom in pool-4 is ~6%. preemptible-cold headroom ~30%. Applying softcap should stabilize quickly.
alert-bot: [telemetry] slab-eviction-rate for eventhorizon spike x4 at 13:04; rack-9 packet retransmits +18% (link: https://telemetry.redwood/egress/1777779100).
Lena (sre): actionable steps: 1) qosctl set --tenant=eventhorizon --max-egress=160mbps --ttl=20m --tag=egress-contain 2) routerctl prefix add --tenant=eventhorizon --prefix=batch/emb --target=preemptible-cold --force --ttl=2h 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 and kv-rehydrate-rate for 15m.
Diego (platform): add `no-auto-evict=true` annotation so auto-scheduler won't preempt their dedicated slices. Also set `kvcache-stitch=false` for preemptible-cold to avoid extra prefetch cost.
Arun (infra): running dry-run for both commands now, will apply if outputs look sane.
infra-oncall: dry-run OK. Applying QoS and prefix route in 1m. I'll watch packet drops and eviction rate.
Lena (sre): watching dashboards. 5m after apply: p95 back near baseline, kv-eviction-rate down ~60%. No NVLink/thermal alerts.
Marta (sales-eng): TAM confirmed they paused some of the sweep jobs. They appreciate the coordinated approach.
Arun (infra): plan to keep softcap for 20m then remove if stable. Will post a short incident note with timestamps and commands executed.
alert-bot: [action] qos applied at 2026-04-07T13:07:12Z (change-id q-1777779100).
